title: Repo-Wide CQRS Violation Audit
description: Repo-wide CQRS compliance audit: catalog technologies where mutations bypass semantic Operation dispatch (TS setDocument-only ledgers, coarse SetNodes/SetFlow bulk ops, direct fixture spread mutations, missing WASM store gates). Prioritize remediation after Trinity Jack CQRS gate.
summary:
Extended CQRS to all DocumentVcs-backed play technologies.

- Added semantic backwards*EditOp for flow, DAG, GIS, shooting, puzzle 3d/5d, presentation, forms, draw, raster, writer (inverse ops where practical; pre-apply projection snapshot for complex/destructive ops).
- Writer: setText semantic op; playground editor routes text-only edits through setText instead of blind setDocument.
- Raster: setBrushOpacity semantic op; play no longer spreads projection for brush opacity.
- Wired backwardsOp/diffOp in all play docStores (flow, dag, procedural, gis, shooting, puzzle 3d/5d).

Out of scope: Puzzle 2d play (canvas/Rust Puzzle2dOp), Semios native dispatch, Tier B Rust coarse ops, retiring TS mirror entirely.
